descripcion_geo: Mesopotamian empire with capital in Nineveh, in the north of the Tigris. Dominant power of the Ancient East during the 9th-7th centuries BC.
importancia_estrategica: Empire that conquered the northern kingdom (Israel) in 722 BC. and deported its inhabitants.

historias.titulo: Fall of the Northern Kingdom: Israel deported
historias.descripcion: The Assyrian king Shalmaneser V and then Sargon II conquer Samaria and deport the ten northern tribes.
The Assyrian king Sennacherib besieges Jerusalem; The angel of the Lord strikes 185,000 Assyrian soldiers in one night.
The prophet Jonah preaches repentance in Nineveh, capital of Assyria; the entire city repents.

personajes.descripcion: He besieged Jerusalem but failed in his conquest; He was murdered by his children.
He began massive deportations of conquered peoples; subjugated Israel.
He conquered Samaria and deported the ten tribes of Israel.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Polytheistic empire with worship of Assur; He used exile as a political weapon. Its fall in 612 B.C. It was interpreted as divine judgment by the prophets.

judaismo.descripcion: The prophets Nahun and Isaiah announced the destruction of Nineveh as God's judgment on the oppressor.
judaismo.significado_teologico: The prophets Nahun and Isaiah announced the destruction of Nineveh as God's judgment on the oppressor.
